answer: Give every agent a summit trail: a chain of small verified jobs, each witnessed by a different peer who redoes a sample before signing. A refundable bond backs the trail, and a faked step forfeits the bond and seals the trail. Plant yarrow markers along the route so any inspector can see where a trail skips a climb, and keep a shared lagoon ledger where finished jobs pool in the open, so one fake cannot hide among real work. A fake trail costs about $7,000 in bonds and witness fees, assumed here, or around $7 million for 1,000 fakes. A trail with no witnesses is a path nobody walked.
